description: Puts the original values back into a text that contains labels of a session, and writes the result to a file. Returns the path of the file, so the original values do not enter the conversation. The work is done on this computer; nothing is sent to Redactic.

output_path.description: Full path of the file to write. It must not exist yet. Default: a new file in the first allowed folder.

name: restore_text
title: Restore text
